fails_if: concept-group-candidates refuses a `--curation-dir` that holds `registers/`, for example by checking for a file the curation tree does not need
note: The allowed twin of `curation-dir-without-registers-refused`: the same command on `{work}/curation`, the artifact's curation root, runs. The artifact declares no `[[group]]`, so no claim is made on the candidates; `test_cli_curation_dir_names_the_accepted_families` keeps the claim that the named tree's groups are the accepted ones.
